rejected.finding: Texas Water Code section 16.012 text, survey and penalty subsections (source 3)
rejected.reason: Unreachable as text. https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/WA/htm/WA.16.htm and the ?tab=1&code=WA&chapter=WA.16&artSec=16.012 form both returned only site navigation with no statute language, so no subsection could be quoted. The 16.012(m) citation is carried only through the water board's FAQ (c51) and the ERCOT notice (c17). The statute itself is not in the record.

rejected.finding: ERCOT issued the notice jointly with the PUC and the water board
rejected.reason: The notice never says jointly. It says ERCOT coordinated with the PUC and the TWDB to develop the Section C questions, and that the TWDB's Executive Administrator authorized ERCOT to issue them. ERCOT is the issuer. Recorded as c12 and c14 in those terms.

rejected.finding: Section C asks about water source, volume and cooling type
rejected.reason: The notice page doesn't list the Section C questions. It says only that Section C seeks information about water sources and consumption (c13). Cooling technologies show up in the topic list for the whole RFI (c11) and are not tied to Section C. The question list would be in the RFI document, which wasn't fetched.

rejected.finding: RFI responses will be published only in aggregate
rejected.reason: The words aggregate and confidential don't appear on the notice page. The page says only that ERCOT will work with the PUC to publish a report of conclusions (c25, c26).

rejected.finding: Tribune response rate of 28% in 2024 with 67 facilities surveyed
rejected.reason: Seen only in the fetch tool's summary. No verbatim sentence with 28% or 67 was returned, so it wasn't verified.

rejected.finding: Tribune figure that nearly 30% of the 329 surveyed in 2025 responded
rejected.reason: Two targeted fetches returned different sentences for this passage. One was 'Last year, 329 data centers were surveyed.' and the other was 'And last year, 329 data centers were surveyed and nearly 30% submitted responses.' Without one confirmed string the 30% figure fails. The 329 figure is carried by c44.

rejected.finding: Tribune figure that nearly a third of 22 data centers surveyed in 2023 responded
rejected.reason: The quote checked out, but it was left out to keep the claim count in range. It's peripheral to the story. Not a verification failure.

rejected.finding: The Tribune ties the survey penalties to TCEQ by that acronym

rejected.finding: The Tribune's October 14th article mentions ERCOT's Request for Information
